notes: New: long lists such as a school-wide class list of 600+ students now print and save as PDF instead of failing. Urdu student names print correctly in the class list. Very long notes no longer break the table reports and the ledger PDF. The User Guide PDF works with an Urdu school name and the User Guide has its own button in Settings. Includes everything from 1.3.9: Set B papers keep a fixed order, MCQ checker Set A/B, correct marks for Attempt any X of Y, bulk actions, print/PDF/CSV buttons, admission date filter and a safer network sync.
